component.name: SelfSteam
component.summary: Add Steam shortcuts with artwork from another device

description.p: SelfSteam is a headless companion that adds non-Steam shortcuts -- streaming services, RetroArch cores, and standalone emulators -- complete with SteamGridDB artwork, from a phone or another computer on the same network, while the target machine stays in Steam's Game Mode. A pairing code shown on screen is the only access control, no accounts needed.

ul.li: Add xemu's missing Hard Disk Image slot (xemu needs 4 files, not 3), with a link to xemu's own free legal image
Make xemu's EEPROM slot optional and last in the list, since xemu auto-generates a default if none is provided
Set xemu to use the Vulkan renderer automatically on shortcut creation
Fix Flathub-installed emulator shortcuts routing Edit to the URL tab instead of the Emulators tab
Fix BIOS/keys/firmware files (xemu, and any other Flathub emulator) silently failing to save -- other Flatpak apps' own config directories weren't actually reachable from the sandbox
Add a standalone /custom page for editing non-SelfSteam shortcuts (Target/Start In/Launch options/Name, no tabs, no extra button)
SteamGridDB artwork search runs automatically as soon as the page loads
Name field defaults to the shortcut's real saved name instead of a re-guess

description.p: Revert the Custom tab for editing non-SelfSteam shortcuts (still listed, just not editable here yet).
Show all non-Steam shortcuts, not just ones SelfSteam itself created.
Fix the pairing-code screen not appearing at all in gamescope sessions (missing DISPLAY in the sandbox).
Fix the pairing-code screen failing to launch under Flatpak.
